_comment: Registry for dataset_domains.py. role: prod | train | test | candidate. split_col splits a manifest into domains by that column; without it the whole source is one domain. meta_cols (list or {column: name}) are kept per sample for the production breakdown. group_by: auto (frames/ folders are one video, other files stand alone) | parent (the folder holding the file) | file; a `group` column overrides it. Set "thumbs": false to keep a source out of thumbnails. Paths are relative to the repo root.
